arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/apispec/ext/marshmallow/common.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('apispec.ext.marshmallow.common')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from marshmallow import Schema,fields
from apispec.ext.marshmallow.common import get_fields
class Item(Schema):
 value=fields.Integer()
 output=fields.String(dump_only=True)
instance=Item()
instance_fields=get_fields(instance)
class_fields=get_fields(Item)
print('field_ownership',instance_fields['value'] is instance.fields['value'],class_fields['value'] is Item._declared_fields['value'])
assert instance_fields['value'] is instance.fields['value']
assert class_fields['value'] is not Item._declared_fields['value']
assert 'output' not in get_fields(Item,exclude_dump_only=True)

PYREPLAY
